annotations.title: Check an MCP server before connecting

description: Read another MCP server's tool list the way you'd meet it and report what should change how you use it: text aimed at the model (tool poisoning), missing or contradictory safety hints, undocumented parameters, names model APIs reject, and what the list costs in tokens. Use it before adding a server you don't know. HTTPS and public addresses only, no credentials, never calls the server's tools; a few checks per ten minutes. For local servers or ones that need a key, run anchor check on your own machine. What each check looks for: https://www.anchorterminal.com/check

budget.description: Optional: flag the list as an error if its definitions cost more tokens than this

url.description: The server's Streamable HTTP endpoint, e.g. https://mcp.example.com/mcp
